name: In Assembly
thesis: A personal portfolio arranged like an assembly, with Raygen’s name, notes, and navigation orbiting a real machine at its center.
interaction: See inside crossfades the precisely aligned SERV0 renders, shifts the presentation plane, and reveals an explanatory leader line and motion note.
why: The page makes the act of understanding a printer its opening gesture, then follows Raygen’s mechanical curiosity through DAVID and Hack Club.
